notes: Prompt layout config: choose which modules to inject and their order. See memory/README.md for detailed explanations.

section_docs.system_role: Inject epm/memory/prompt_modules/system_role.txt into SYSTEM (role + completion criteria).
section_docs.body_rules: Inject epm/memory/body_rules_en.txt into SYSTEM (filtered to remove the legacy [Capabilities - cookbench_api list] block).
section_docs.strategy_notes: Inject epm/memory/strategy_notes_en.txt into SYSTEM (planning guidance, common-sense notes, and execution heuristics).
section_docs.put_place_occupancy: Inject memory/put_place_occupancy.json into SYSTEM (free/occupied placement points snapshot).
section_docs.tool_interaction_point_list: Inject epm/data/tool_interaction_point_list.json into SYSTEM (tool interaction point categories and index/name templates).
section_docs.tool_en_catalog: Inject selected fields from epm/data/tool_en.json into SYSTEM: tool_name, tool_type, container_type, tool_function, capacity, supported_operation_states. Controlled by brain.prompt_policy.include_tool_en_catalog.
section_docs.supported_items: Inject epm/memory/supported_items.txt into SYSTEM (static supported item/platform/tool names).
section_docs.reflexion_memory: Inject epm/memory/reflexion_memory.txt into SYSTEM (short lessons learned).
section_docs.reflexion_progress_memory: Inject memory/reflexion_progress_memory.txt into SYSTEM (short recent progress summaries for the current episode).
section_docs.tools_manifest_openai: Inject epm/memory/tools_manifest_openai_en.json (fallback: tools_manifest_openai.json) verbatim as authoritative schemas.
section_docs.skill_cards: Inject category-based Skill Cards (derived from skills_catalog.json). Controlled by skill_cards_mode: 'all' injects all categories; 'selected' injects a small subset chosen from the current goal/recipe/feedback.
section_docs.parameter_heuristics: Inject parameter heuristics JSON (memory_dir/parameter_heuristics.json) as action templates / defaults / ranges.
section_docs.goal: High-level goal id + natural language goal.
section_docs.recipe_text: Raw recipe text for the current dish.
section_docs.task_execution_context: Dynamic execution-scope summary for the current prompt, such as active dish ids, submission count, and dish-vs-component interpretation rules.
section_docs.observation: Observation input. With observation_mode=image_only, only states whether a screenshot image is provided.
section_docs.agent_state: Inject agent state snapshot (JSON) from agent_state.json. This is used to expose held item/modes/etc.
section_docs.resume_state: Inject resume state snapshot (JSON) from resume_state.json so the planner can continue from persisted progress/failure context instead of restarting.
section_docs.countdown_status: Inject countdown/timer status derived from agent_state (force-submit remaining steps + timers/events). Always rendered with a placeholder when unavailable.
section_docs.visual_anomaly_feedback: Inject the latest multimodal visual anomaly warning produced after execution, such as overflow, drop, occlusion, or unstable placement risk.
section_docs.precondition_feedback: Inject the latest EPM precondition-check feedback / sequence-repair guidance for the planner.
section_docs.query_memory: Inject cross-step cached query_scene_objects results (recent query -> top candidates with instance_id/distance/container) for reuse in subsequent planning steps.
section_docs.percept_text: Optional perception summary text (if enabled by prompt_policy.include_percept).
section_docs.action_memory: Inject epm/memory/action_memory.json for EPM only (reusable action templates and static parameter heuristics).
section_docs.task_progress: Optional EPM-only task progress snapshot (if enabled by prompt_policy.include_task_progress).
section_docs.task_progress_feedback: Inject the latest semantic task-progress summary feedback produced by the task_progress maintainer.
section_docs.instance_id_selection: When feedback contains blocking=instance_disambiguation, planner enters instance_id selection mode. Output must be JSON with only {name, instance_id}; executor will retry the previous failed step using these values.
